Last year, the Cosmic Orange iPhone 17 Pro was an instant hit when it launched, but rumours suggest the iPhone 18 Pro will switch to an all-new burgundy colour to replace it. Read on for the latest leaks on what to expect from the new model.

iPhone 18 Pro: A Sneak Peek at the Signature New Colour

Apple has traditionally played it safe with muted, understated colour options for its Pro iPhone lineup. But with the iPhone 17 Pro, the company made a bold departure from its usual black-and-white palette, introducing the eye-catching Cosmic Orange — which quickly became a hit.

Rumour has it that Apple intends to carry this same bold colour philosophy forward to the iPhone 18 Pro.

This time, however, instead of orange, the lineup is expected to come in three (possibly four) colour options:

  • Burgundy / Deep Cherry
  • Light Blue
  • Silver
  • Possibly Dark Grey

It's still unclear whether a dark grey or black option will be released this year, but there's already strong consensus on the remaining three colours.

Among them, the Deep Cherry / Burgundy is expected to be the brand-new signature colour that Apple will heavily promote.

Leaker Fixed Focus Digital posted on Weibo today, saying he had previously seen different shades of this colour circulating online. However, he believes the correct tone is the darker variant — a purple-tinged red, similar to cherry.

Some reports have simply referred to the colour as "red" or "dark red", which may explain why some dummy units appear in lighter, redder tones. But according to the leaker, what we'll ultimately see is a cherry tone with a more purple cast.

What do you think of the rumoured signature new colour for the iPhone 18 Pro? Share your thoughts in the comments below.
